plans.name: SAFE
plans.description: Only EXACT transformations. Mathematical result preserved.

recommendations.what_detected: Loops detected that may resubmit identical circuits
recommendations.why_expensive: Identical circuits submitted multiple times to QPU
recommendations.alternative: Cache results for identical circuit+parameter combinations
recommendations.evidence: Loop structures detected alongside QPU calls — caching may eliminate redundant submissions

recommendations.what_detected: NetworkX graph operations detected alongside quantum workload
recommendations.why_expensive: Graph optimization problems may contain trivially reducible components
recommendations.alternative: Apply classical graph preprocessing: component reduction, symmetry, sparsification, isolated-node removal
recommendations.estimated_qpu_saving: Reduces problem size — savings depend on graph structure
recommendations.expected_quality_risk: None — preprocessing preserves exact problem structure
recommendations.validation_experiment: Verify reduced graph produces same optimal solution
recommendations.evidence: NetworkX detected — graph preprocessing can reduce QPU workload

plans.name: BALANCED
plans.description: EXACT + EQUIVALENT + low-risk APPROXIMATE transformations. Requires user-configured tolerance ε.

recommendations.what_detected: Uniform high shot budget: 2000 shots per circuit
recommendations.alternative: Subsample existing bitstrings at reduced shot counts, compare metrics
recommendations.expected_quality_risk: Increased estimator variance — requires tolerance configuration
recommendations.validation_experiment: Subsample at 2000, 1000, 500 shots, compare task metric within 95% CI
recommendations.evidence: Shot budget of 2000 may be higher than necessary for convergence
